property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v arrays, transfer(...) either reverts during one of the external calls or returns true; if it returns, it must return true (i.e., successful completion implies true).
For any non-empty _tos with matching v length, calling transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., successful call returns true).
If transfer does not revert, it returns true and makes no change observable to address(c).balance (i.e., it does not transfer Ether).
